ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; visible surface is approximately 95% dark-grey/black with high-intensity white pixels restricted to sparse punctate speckling and water interaction at the base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous field of low-intensity pixels. Occasional high-contrast white dots (1-3 pixel diameter) scattered across both lobes. A series of three distinct, low-contrast circular rings are visible on the medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth-to-lobe-width ratio of approximately 0.15.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire margin; peaks are sharper and more prominent (3-7 pixel amplitude) on the outer lateral thirds of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the primary visible edges, tapering to narrow, pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, multi-colored (white, tan, orange) pixel groups at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; five distinct circular ring-scars are localized in a cluster on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified biological colonization (barnacles) at the distal lobe tips; circular scarring pattern on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of distinct orange-brown pigmentation at the lateral fluke tips, contrasting with the primary black pigmentation.
